CustomField.description: Resolves a PHOCS HA hierarchy Account to its level 1 Health Authority Account ID.
CustomField.formula: IF( FacilityHierarchy__r.RecordType.DeveloperName <> "HA_Hierarchy", "", IF( ISPICKVAL(FacilityHierarchy__r.Type, "1-HA"), CASESAFEID(FacilityHierarchy__c), IF( ISPICKVAL(FacilityHierarchy__r.Type, "2-HSDA"), CASESAFEID(FacilityHierarchy__r.ParentId), IF( ISPICKVAL(FacilityHierarchy__r.Type, "3-LHA"), CASESAFEID(FacilityHierarchy__r.Parent.ParentId), IF( ISPICKVAL(FacilityHierarchy__r.Type, "4-CHSA"), CASESAFEID(FacilityHierarchy__r.Parent.Parent.ParentId), "" ) ) ) ) )
CustomField.label: Hierarchy HA ID
